events.title: The free demo is in Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Net Worthless is in Steam Next Fest from October 19 to 26, and the free demo is right here on this page. The demo gives you one character, the Student: eighteen, broke, and juggling rent, health and happiness on whatever a first job pays. A run takes about an hour and has a clear ending. You win when he builds the net worth his goal asks for or lands a Tier 2 job. I put together a build for the fest with the things I wanted in before this week: The end of a run tells the whole run. events.title: Time played on every run, and inflation that moves
events.summary: Build 1.0.1210. A smaller one: a clock on your runs, a renamed button, and inflation that finally does something. Time played. Every run now counts the real time you spend on it. Load Game shows it next to each run, the end-of-run screen has its own Time played row, and the Hall of Fame lists it under each run's end date. Runs you finished before this build show a dash, because nothing was counting back then. Next Turn. The end-of-month button has a shorter name and wears its Space keycap. Since

events.title: The demo on a gamepad, and two trades without a degree
events.summary: Build 1.0.3009. Most of this one went into a controller. Since build 0.5.2708 you could finish a run without touching the mouse. You still could not play it from the couch: the game did not know a gamepad existed. I played it with a pad in my hands, fixed everything that got in the way, and it now plays start to finish on one. events.title: The demo moves to version 1.0
events.summary: Exactly two months to release! Build 1.0.1509. This is the final version of the demo: polished, updated on your feedback, and brought in line with everything that has happened to the rest of the game since the last build. The version number is the release one now, but the demo's scope is what it was: one run, as the Student. The rest is for the full game :) Here is what is new. "Choose Your Destiny". events.title: Goods wear out, birthdays, and long runs stop lagging
events.summary: Build 0.5.0109. The biggest demo update so far, and most of it comes from watching people play the last one. One thing first. Someone reported that the game got slower and slower over a long run while memory stayed flat. That was real. Every store window you had ever opened was being rebuilt behind the scenes on every money change of the month tick, the journal re-sorted its whole list for each new entry, and saving and the event roll did work that grew with the length of the run. events.title: Burnout you can actually catch, and the whole game on a keyboard
events.summary: Build 0.5.2708. A smaller one than last time, but two of the items are things people asked for by name. Burnout has been in the game since the first build. Nobody ever saw it. The trigger counted hours you cannot actually schedule, so the heaviest debuff in the game was sitting there unreachable, and if it had fired, it would have landed with no explanation. events.title: Your job now has events of its own
events.summary: Build 0.5.1708. Most of this one is your job. Events used to happen to you regardless of what you did for a living. A barista and a CTO got the same month. Three of the jobs you can hold in the demo now have events written only for them, forty four in total, with their own art, and they only draw while you actually work there. events.title: Net Worthless comes out on November 16
events.summary: Net Worthless comes out on November 16. Before anything else, thank you. For the reviews, for the wishlists, for the bug reports, for the hours you have put into the demo. More than a thousand of you have played it since July 31, and the number is still going up. The question we get most often is when the full version arrives. Today we can answer it: November 16. events.title: The demo gets a new look
events.summary: Build 0.5.0508. Most of this one is the interface. A new type voice. Window titles, buttons, the month banner and every figure now use a condensed all-caps face instead of the old mix of body text and monospace labels. A new accent color. The indigo is gone. The UI runs on a warm terracotta sampled from the Student's hoodie, and the logo dropped the indigo too. It crashes downhill in red now. Solid panels. events.title: First demo patch is out
events.summary: The demo has its first patch, build 0.5.0108. Almost everything in it comes from the first days after release: watching your playthroughs and reading the reports. The "new listings" dot tells the truth now. The Jobs and Rentals tabs kept lighting their attention dot every month even when nothing new appeared, because the monthly approval-odds update counted as news. events.title: The free demo is out
events.summary: The free demo of Net Worthless is out. You can play it right now on this page. The demo is limited to one character: the Student. There's no time limit, but his dream is one of the easier ones, so a full run as him is much shorter than runs as the other characters will be at release. If you've already seen the demo in someone's video, that was an early build. Here's what changed since then: Study and career progress right on the job board. events.title: The free demo goes live on July 31
events.summary: The free demo of Net Worthless goes live on this page on July 31. It's the Student run, the opening of the game, about an hour or two of play. He's just arrived in the city with a simple dream: land a decent job or build up some starting net worth. Will you be able to do it? Before you ask: Same systems and same balance as the full game.
